title: Upstream timeout boundaries
summary: proxy_read_timeout bounds inactivity between successive reads, not whole-response duration. A 504 and an outer collector deadline are distinct observations.
checks: Compare upstream response timing, proxy policy and the bounded route contract.
limitations: Status alone cannot identify the active timeout directive.
applicability: Nginx proxy module; live verified on 1.28
